operator_prerequisites.op_step_0a: Confirm execution approval phrase typed exactly (see Phase H); paste into a separate signed log file in this run directory
operator_prerequisites.op_step_0b: Confirm BASE_RPC_PRIMARY env var is set to a paid endpoint (recommended) OR explicitly accept publicnode for this run only
operator_prerequisites.op_step_0c: Confirm no lpbot-live / lpbot-canary / lpbot-paper / other trading processes are running on the host
operator_prerequisites.op_step_0d: Confirm wallet funding hasn't changed materially since dry-run Phase E (USDC > 22, ETH gas > $0.20)
operator_prerequisites.op_step_0e: Confirm operator can monitor for 15m (or 30m if extension) and respond to stop conditions

step_0_pre_execution_sanity.purpose: Validate every assumption in the dry-run builder is still true at execution time

actions.action: eth_chainId from RPC
Read wallet ETH balance via eth_getBalance
Read USDC balanceOf(wallet)
Read WETH balanceOf(wallet)
Read USDC.allowance(wallet, NPM)
actions.expect: current allowance (logged); for 10U: needs < 10; for 20U: needs < 20

actions.action: Read WETH.allowance(wallet, NPM)
Read pool.slot0() — current tick and sqrtPriceX96
actions.expect: current_tick inside or near frozen range [-200643, -200243]; if drifted more than half-range, halt and request fresh tick range approval
actions.halt_if: current_tick outside the new half-range envelope

actions.action: Read pool.liquidity()
actions.expect: > 1e15 (1e15 wei L = 1e15 / 1e6 USDC = 1e9 USDC of one-sided LP, plenty)

actions.action: QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle(WETH→USDC, amount=10 USDC worth of WETH)
QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle(USDC→WETH, amount=10 USDC)
eth_estimateGas for mint call (with current allowances)
actions.expect: estimate_gas returned and within 2x of inherited 180,000

actions.action: Read current gas price; compute total cost USD = (approve_gas + mint_gas + decrease_gas + collect_gas + 2*revoke_gas) * gas_price * weth_usd
Set up hold timer (15m default; max 30m if extension approved)

step_1_approve_exact_only_if_needed.purpose: Ensure NPM has exact USDC allowance for the chosen notional; never ApproveMax

actions.action: Compute approve_amount_raw for chosen notional
actions.rule: 10U → 10_000_000 raw USDC; 20U → 20_000_000 raw USDC. If current USDC allowance already >= approve_amount_raw, skip the approve tx entirely.
actions.halt_if: approve_amount_raw > 50_000_000 (sanity ceiling — anything bigger means notional was misconfigured)

actions.action: Build ERC20.approve(USDC, NPM, approve_amount_raw) tx
actions.invariant: amount_raw <= 50_000_000 AND amount_raw == chosen notional in raw USDC (ApproveExact; never uint256.max)

actions.action: Sign with wallet; broadcast via eth_sendRawTransaction
Wait for >= 12 block confirmations
actions.halt_if: tx reverts OR mempool stall > 5 min

actions.action: Re-read USDC.allowance(wallet, NPM) on-chain
actions.halt_if: allowance != approve_amount_raw (record actual; if it matches, proceed)

weth_approve.default: skip (WETH amount in mint is 0 wei, so no WETH approve needed)
weth_approve.exception: if a Step 0 sanity check shows WETH balance > 0 AND the chosen range ends up needing non-zero WETH, do not silently approve — HALT and request new approval

step_2_mint_or_increaseLiquidity.purpose: Open the LP position; record tokenId for downstream telemetry

actions.action: Build NPM.mint(tuple) call with the values from the dry-run builder
actions.parameters_locked: token0, token1, fee=100, tickLower=-200643, tickUpper=-200243, amount0Desired=0, amount1Desired=10e6 (or 20e6), amount0Min=0, amount1Min=9949999 (or 19899999), recipient=wallet, deadline=now+1h

actions.action: Sign with wallet; broadcast via eth_sendRawTransaction
Wait for >= 12 block confirmations
actions.halt_if: tx reverts OR mempool stall > 5 min

actions.action: Decode the ERC721 Transfer event log (NPM emits Transfer(from=0, to=wallet, tokenId=...))
record: liquidity (uint128) from PositionManager.IncreaseLiquidity event if available

actions.action: Call NPM.positions(tokenId) to read canonical position state
Call ERC20.balanceOf(wallet) for WETH and USDC; record actual deposited amounts (delta vs pre-mint)

step_2_mint_or_increaseLiquidity.no_increaseLiquidity: this run is single-mint only; increaseLiquidity on an existing position is a different future stage

step_3_hold_monitoring.purpose: Record actual position state every minute for telemetry

actions.action: Every 60s for hold_window (15m default; 30m if extension approved):
sub_actions: Compute mark-to-market: tokensOwed0/1 valued in USDC at current spot
Record: block_number, tick, liquidity, feeGrowthInside0/1, tokensOwed0/1, mtm_usd, mtm_pnl_vs_entry

actions.action: Continuously monitor for any Stop Condition in Phase E; on any stop, abort hold and jump to Step 4 immediately
If hold completes without stop, proceed to Step 4 at end of hold_window

step_4_exit_decrease_collect.purpose: Close the position; collect fees + principal back to wallet

actions.action: Build NPM.decreaseLiquidity(tokenId, liquidity=full, amount0Min=0, amount1Min=computed_with_slippage, deadline=now+1h)
Wait for >= 12 block confirmations; halt if revert
Build NPM.collect(tokenId, recipient=wallet, amount0Max=uint128.max, amount1Max=uint128.max)
Wait for >= 12 block confirmations; halt if revert
Call NPM.positions(tokenId) again to confirm liquidity=0 and tokensOwed=0
Call ERC20.balanceOf(wallet) for WETH and USDC; record post-collect balances; compute deltas
DO NOT swap-back WETH → USDC. The probe exits in WETH+USDC. Swap-back requires a separate approval stage.
Build ERC20.approve(USDC, NPM, 0) to revoke USDC allowance
Build ERC20.approve(WETH, NPM, 0) IF the WETH allowance was non-zero (legacy ApproveExact leftover). Use the existing allowance() read to decide.
Wait for >= 12 block confirmations on each revoke
Final balance snapshot: ETH native, WETH, USDC

Generate final actual_pnl report (see Phase F telemetry spec): entry_principal_usd, gas_spent_usd, slippage_cost_usd, fees_collected_usd, il_proxy_usd, net_pnl_usd, hold_duration_seconds, success_status
Commit all telemetry to this run directory; mark run as complete
